name: Cheese Croquettes
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: 1 cup mild cheese, cut in very small cubes

steps: Make a thick white sauce, using butter, flour, and milk, add yolks of eggs without first beating, and stir until well mixed; then add grated cheese.
As soon as cheese melts, remove from fire, fold in cheese cubes, and season with salt, pepper, and cayenne.
Spread in a shallow pan, and cool.
Turn on a board, cut in small squares or strips, dip in crumbs, egg, and crumbs again, fry in deep fat, and drain on brown paper.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
